note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Nature (sql/09_dimension_nature.sql) as deployed. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. RiskType 3 = Critical. Overdue is a live figure: a check run later can differ slightly from the report.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @WindowStart DATETIME = '{WindowStart}';
DECLARE @WindowEnd DATETIME = '{WindowEnd}';
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
-- Step 1. Obligations this user is allowed to see, with their nature (Compliance.NatureOfCompliance)
--         and the penalty columns of the Compliance master (fixed / variable fine amounts, forceful closure).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#inst') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #inst;
SELECT s.ComplianceInstanceID, s.BranchID, s.RiskType, s.Imprisonment, s.NatureOfCompliance AS NatureId,
CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.FixedMinimum,0) > 0 OR ISNULL(c.FixedMaximum,0) > 0 OR ISNULL(c.VariableAmountPerDay,0) > 0
OR ISNULL(c.VariableAmountPerMonth,0) > 0 OR ISNULL(c.VariableAmountPerInstance,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HasFinancialPenalty,
CASE WHEN c.IsForcefulClosure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HasClosureRisk
INTO #inst
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopedInstances(@UserID, @CustomerID) s JOIN Compliance c ON c.ID = s.ComplianceID;
-- Step 2. Keep only obligations with at least one due date inside the report period (ComplianceScheduleOn.ScheduleOn).
DELETE i FROM #inst i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceScheduleOn cso
WHERE cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
AND cso.ScheduleOn >= @WindowStart AND cso.ScheduleOn < @WindowEnd);
-- Step 3. Obligations overdue right now: past due and not closed, or never touched (ComplianceScheduleOn, ComplianceTransaction).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ovd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ovd;
SELECT DISTINCT o.ComplianceInstanceID INTO #ovd
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOverdueSchedules(@CustomerID, @AsOf) o
JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = o.ComplianceInstanceID;
-- Step 4. Obligations with a performer named on the obligation itself (ComplianceAssignment, RoleID 3).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#owned') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #owned;
SELECT ComplianceInstanceID INTO #owned
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOwnership(@UserID, @CustomerID) WHERE HasInstanceOwner = 1;

checks.name: All obligations in the report
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Obligations with a nature (sum of all nature rows)
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Obligations with no nature
checks.tables: Compliance.NatureOfCompliance is blank. N2 + N3 = N1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId IS NULL;

checks.name: Overdue obligations
checks.tables: Step 3. Live - can move between runs.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #ovd;

checks.name: Overall overdue rate (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ovd) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value;

checks.name: Share of obligations with a possible prison term (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Imprisonment = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Natures that have obligations
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NatureId) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Obligations in an "Other..." nature
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN NatureOfCompliance n ON n.ID = i.NatureId WHERE n.Name LIKE N'Other%';

checks.name: Obligations with no real category ("Other..." plus no nature)
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN NatureOfCompliance n ON n.ID = i.NatureId
WHERE i.NatureId IS NULL OR n.Name LIKE N'Other%';

checks.name: Share with no real category (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.NatureId IS NULL OR n.Name LIKE N'Other%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN NatureOfCompliance n ON n.ID = i.NatureId;

checks.name: A nature's obligations
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId = {RowKey};

checks.name: A nature's overdue obligations
checks.tables: This nature's obligations that are in step 3.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.NatureId = {RowKey};

checks.name: A nature's overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / obligations x 100, for this nature.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.NatureId = {RowKey};

checks.name: A nature's obligations with no performer on the obligation itself
checks.tables: This nature's obligations not in step 4. Most still have a performer on each due date (ComplianceScheduleOn.Performerid).
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #owned w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.NatureId = {RowKey} AND w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL;

checks.name: A nature's obligations with a possible prison term
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId = {RowKey} AND Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: A nature's overdue obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1 and overdue now, this nature.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.NatureId = {RowKey} AND i.Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: A nature's Critical-risk obligations
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId = {RowKey} AND RiskType = 3;

checks.name: Locations where a nature applies
checks.tables: Distinct CustomerBranch of this nature's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BranchID) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId = {RowKey};

checks.name: A nature's obligations with any penalty (fine, prison or forced closure)
checks.tables: Any fine amount on Compliance, or Imprisonment = 1, or IsForcefulClosure = 1.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId = {RowKey} AND (HasFinancialPenalty = 1 OR Imprisonment = 1 OR HasClosureRisk = 1);

checks.name: A nature's obligations with a fine
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId = {RowKey} AND HasFinancialPenalty = 1;

checks.name: A nature's obligations that can force closure
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId = {RowKey} AND HasClosureRisk = 1;

checks.name: A nature's share with a possible prison term (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Imprisonment = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst WHERE NatureId = {RowKey};

checks.name: All overdue obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1 and overdue now, every nature.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.Imprisonment = 1 AND i.NatureId IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Natures with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Natures where T5 is more than 0.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NatureId) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE NatureId IS NOT NULL AND Imprisonment = 1;
